name: closeyourit-nuxt4-proof
//: @simple-git/argv-parser 1.1.1 has a critical flaw: the check simple-git uses to block dangerous
Git options does not recognise include.path, submodule.<name>.update, url.<base>.insteadOf,
--exec-path and the replacement of internal binaries, so it lets command execution through.
Fixed from 2.0.1. It comes from simple-git 3.36.0 (latest 3.x, accepts only ^1.1.0), via
@nuxt/devtools 3.4.x which nuxt 4.5.2 requires: development panel only, it does not end up in the
example's build nor in the published package. No stable version of @nuxt/devtools accepts
simple-git 4, so 2.0.1 is forced (same vulnerabilityCheck API). When devtools updates
the override must be removed by hand. See CYJS-49.
braces 3.0.3 stays vulnerable by choice (accepted risk): a path pattern with deeply nested braces
can exhaust resources during expansion and block the process. It comes from
micromatch 4.0.8 via fast-glob 3.3.3 and globby 16.x, which nitropack 2.13.4 uses to look up files
only while it prepares and builds the example: it does not run in the started server nor end up in
the published package. No version of braces fixes the flaw yet, so an override would not help
and the lockfile stays as it is. To be rechecked as soon as a fixed version of braces is out: at
that point it is updated and this note must be removed. See CYJS-51.
node-forge 1.4.0 stays vulnerable by choice (accepted risk): signature verification can
accept a certificate with a forged signature. It comes from listhen 1.10.1, the package that starts
the local development server, which @nuxt/cli 3.37.0 and nitropack 2.13.4 (both required by
nuxt 4.5.2) use only for the development command: it is not needed by the built site nor ends up in
the published package. No version of node-forge fixes the flaw yet, so an override
would not help and the lockfile stays as it is. To be rechecked as soon as a fixed version of
node-forge is out: at that point it is updated and this note must be removed. See CYJS-53.
simple-git 3.36.0 stays vulnerable by choice (accepted risk) to three flaws: the check on dangerous
Git options is bypassed with abbreviated long options (--receive-p, --exe) and lets commands
run (CYJS-55, fixed from 4.0.0); Git configuration includes are not blocked and
also allow running commands (GHSA-g4wm-2vf7-vfgr, CYJS-56, fixed from
4.0.0); the check does not block the trailer.<name>.command / .cmd configuration, which makes Git run
a command (GHSA-x6jw-m9v5-85vh, CVE-2026-102828, CYJS-57, fixed from 4.0.1).
It comes from @nuxt/devtools 3.4.2 (requires ^3.36.0), the development panel
that nuxt 4.5.2 requires: it is not needed by the built site nor ends up in the published package. Forcing
simple-git 4 breaks the devtools postinstall (4 no longer has the default export), so no
override and the lockfile stays as it is. No stable version of @nuxt/devtools accepts simple-git 4
(only 4.0.0-beta no longer uses it, and nuxt 4.6.1 still requires ^3.4.2). To be rechecked as soon as
nuxt requires a stable version of @nuxt/devtools that accepts simple-git 4 or no longer uses it:
at that point it is updated (at least to 4.0.1) and this note must be removed. See CYJS-55, CYJS-56 and CYJS-57.
